entities.name: Eliza of the Keep
entities.description: Young human necromancer baron of Grixis who ruled the Keep at Ilsun Gate and later Unx.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard of Alara where Eliza dwells.

entities.name: Ilsun Gate
entities.description: Domain in the Dregscape ruled by Eliza.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: Demon given the location of a hidden Hermitage.

entities.name: Sedris
entities.description: Lord who was unwilling to confront Eliza's reanimated dragon.

entities.name: Dregscape
entities.description: Region in which her Keep lies.

events.summary: Eliza carves out a small domain at Ilsun Gate and rules from her Keep.
events.quote: she managed to carve out a small domain at Ilsun Gate

events.summary: Eliza lures Unx's demonic master out by betraying a hidden Hermitage, and takes the necropolis.
events.quote: She successfully launched an attack against the necropolis of Unx, claiming it for her own.

events.summary: Eliza stands down Sedris with a reanimated dragon.

relations.quote: She ruled as baron of the Keep at Ilsun Gate

relations.note: hoped to set the forces against each other
relations.quote: hoping that the two forces would batter themselves against each other
